journey.name: wear restore passphrase
journey.description:
The test phrase restored with a passphrase opens a different wallet: Home shows 0 where the same phrase without a passphrase shows the test wallet's balance (wear restore 12 words). Emulator and physical watch.
Precondition: Fresh app, see journeys/wear/README.md › Fresh app, and a passphrase made up for this run (README › The test wallet: `PASS="watch$(tr -dc a-z </dev/urandom | head -c 6)"`). The test phrase is public, so a fixed passphrase could be funded by anyone; a new one per run is a wallet nobody has seen, which is why the journey can expect 0. Backend: hosted regtest; the empty wallet's first sync takes seconds. The passphrase screen blocks screenshots, so check it with `android layout` only.

actions.action: Type the test phrase (README › Typing several words)
Verify the passphrase field (tag "RestorePassphraseInput") is empty, showing its placeholder "Passphrase"
Type the run's passphrase into "RestorePassphraseInput" (README › Typing: tap the field, Back, then `adb shell input text "$PASS"`; no Enter)
Dump `android layout` every 5 s until it lists "WatchHomeBalance", for up to 2 minutes
